text: The RHP and RLP feature an integrated demand- and supply-side approach, combining voluntary buybacks and home upgrades with the creation of flood-free housing supply. The programs are region-specific, targeting the highest-risk areas with voluntary participation to build community trust. They offer flexibility in co-contributions and provide grants for design and approvals to expedite projects. Partnerships with Landcom, universities, and local councils facilitate the rapid aggregation of flood-free land, with significant milestones including the acquisition of 72 hectares for 400+ lots and a release for up to 1,000 homes in Grafton. The programs are embedded in broader regional resilience packages, addressing interconnected infrastructure and community needs.

Resilient Homes Program (RHP),
